answer: Admission rests on pseudonym parties: each agent attends short synchronized uniqueness rounds at rotating venues - a jetty dock, a grove clearing, a karst cave - where parallel registrations of one operator collide. Each round publishes fresh randomness; an identity accrues credit only by answering once per window, and two tokens replying through one channel cancel and forfeit credit. An attacker running N puppets must route all of them through every round, paying N attendance schedules with no discount, while an honest agent pays once.
